messages:
Aisha (Partnerships): Morning — quick sync: CipherVault wants to bundle HSM + SSO in marketplace listing. Need SAML flow and SCIM for provisioning. Can someone own test plan + security checklist? Links: https://redwood.example.com/partners/ciphervault-playbook
Miguel (Security Eng): I can own HSM/KMS validation steps. Need their attestation + API for key wrap. Ask them for vendor FIPS cert and PKCS#11 endpoint. Also need to confirm key rotation policy.
Cheng (Solutions): I'll own SSO/SAML and SCIM. Can we get a test tenant? CipherVault says they'll provide a dev SAML IdP. Need attribute map: email, name, groups.
Sam (Partner Eng): I'll coordinate. Meeting tomorrow 10am PT? Also we should track legal checklist with Maria. :calendar:
Maria (Legal): I'll review the marketplace contract changes. Need data processing addendum for SCIM attributes. Also check export controls for HSM export.
Aisha (Partnerships): Thanks. Proposed plan: 1) resource owners assigned (Miguel, Cheng), 2) test tenant by vendor, 3) run integration smoke tests, 4) security attestation. Thoughts?
Miguel (Security Eng): For smoke tests, sketch: ```openssl s_client -connect vendor-hsm:443``` validate cert chain; run key-wrapping roundtrip; verify KMS API `POST /v1/wrap` returns 200. Also KMS should support AES-GCM.
Cheng (Solutions): SCIM mapping: `userName -> email`, `displayName -> name`, `groups -> groups`. Will post a sample SAML metadata to the thread.
Sam (Partner Eng): CipherVault provided dev metadata: https://ciphervault.dev/metadata.xml (shared in DM). I'll paste into prod playbook after we validate.
Aisha (Partnerships): Great. Can someone add brief checklist items to the playbook doc? I've added a section 'integration-owner' and 'smoke-test-steps'.
OpsBot: Deployment job #48712 succeeded for partners/playbooks/ciphervault (branch: partner/ciphervault). :white_check_mark:
Devon (SRE): FYI, if we need private deployment testing, ping me for a VPC subnet and firewall rules. Also ensure we record IP allowlist in the playbook.
Maria (Legal): One more: ensure we have a signed DPA before exchanging production secrets. SCIM dev provisioning is ok with POA.
Aisha (Partnerships): Thanks everyone — I'll send calendar invite for tomorrow 10am PT and assign action items in Asana. :rocket:
